On this page: Introduction · Why affordability matters · Fair price model · Services · Home collection · Quality · FAQ

Quality diagnostics should not be a luxury. Remedium Lab is building an accessible pathology network where patients can compare tests, book collection, and receive reports digitally — with pricing that stays visible before you pay.

Introduction

Across India, routine blood tests and preventive health panels remain essential — yet many families delay care because quotes vary widely between centres, add-on fees appear at billing, or reports arrive late. Remedium Lab addresses this gap with a fair price diagnostic approach: list prices patients can see online, standardized collection workflows, and NABL-aligned quality systems operated by Smilecure Lifestyle Pvt. Ltd.

Whether you need a single test such as a CBC or a comprehensive health package, Remedium connects you to participating collection centres and lab test catalog entries you can book from the patient portal.

Why Diagnostic Affordability Matters

Early detection depends on repeat testing — sugar monitoring, thyroid follow-ups, antenatal panels, and employer health drives all require predictable costs. When pricing is opaque, patients skip re-tests or choose unverified providers. Fair, published rates help doctors and patients plan care without compromising quality.

  • Preventive care — affordable panels encourage annual checkups.
  • Chronic disease management — recurring tests become budgetable.
  • Family health — parents and seniors are more likely to test on time.
  • Rural and semi-urban access — hub-and-spoke collection expands reach.

What Fair Price Diagnostics Means

Fair price does not mean compromising accreditation or reagents. At Remedium Lab it means:

  • Transparent test rates shown in the online catalog before checkout.
  • No hidden collection surcharges beyond disclosed home-visit fees where applicable.
  • Standardized TRF and barcoded samples for traceability.
  • Digital reports with reference ranges and authorized signatory review where configured.

Remedium uses the positioning statement India's First Fair Price Diagnostic Lab to communicate this commitment to accessible, quality-first pathology — always subject to company verification and applicable centre availability.

About Remedium Lab

Brand: Remedium Lab
Category: Diagnostic / Pathology Services
Operator: Smilecure Lifestyle Pvt. Ltd.
Services: Blood tests, pathology investigations, health packages, home sample collection, diagnostic collection centres
Service area: India — with participating centres listed on the Find a Centre page (availability varies by city and franchise location).

Remedium Lab is part of the broader Remedium healthcare ecosystem alongside Remedium Aesthetic and Remedium Care, so patients can move from diagnostics to follow-up care when needed.

How the Fair Price Model Works

  1. Discover — search tests or panels on the website catalog.
  2. Compare — view published rates; package savings are shown where configured.
  3. Book — choose centre visit or eligible home collection.
  4. Collect & process — trained phlebotomists and hub/mother-lab processing.
  5. Report — receive digital results on the patient portal when released.

Pricing for individual tests is sourced from the live catalog — we do not publish static rupee examples here because rates may change. Always confirm the current amount at booking time.

Available Diagnostic Services

Remedium Labs supports a wide pathology menu including haematology, biochemistry, serology, urine and stool analysis, hormone assays, and curated wellness packages. Popular searches include:

  • Complete blood count (CBC) and ESR
  • Fasting and post-prandial blood sugar
  • Lipid profile and liver / kidney function tests
  • Thyroid profile (TSH, T3, T4 as configured)
  • Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, iron studies
  • Preventive health checkup bundles

Explore the full list on Lab Tests & Packages.

Home Sample Collection

Eligible patients can schedule home sample collection in supported PIN codes. A trained phlebotomist visits at the chosen slot, verifies identity, collects samples under cold-chain guidelines, and routes them to the processing laboratory. Home collection hours are typically 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM; confirm availability for your location on the booking screen or call the home collection helpline shown in the website footer.

Technology & Digital Reports

Remedium's patient portal lets you track bookings, download reports, and share results with your doctor. Reports are delivered digitally after QC release, reducing unnecessary travel for paper pickup. TRF barcoding and LIS integration support accuracy and turnaround transparency.

Quality & Patient Experience

Quality systems include internal QC, equipment calibration programmes, and NABL-aligned operating procedures where applicable. ISO 9001:2015 certified processes support consistent sample handling from collection to sign-out. Read more on our Accreditations page.

Growing Collection Centre Network

Remedium expands through company-operated and franchise collection centres. Use Find a Centre to locate a hub near you or search by PIN code. Franchise partners follow Remedium SOPs for branding, sample transport, and customer service. Learn about partnership models on the careers and franchise portals where published.

Why Patients Choose Remedium

  • Published, fair pricing on the web catalog
  • Home and centre collection options
  • Digital reports and booking history
  • Integrated Remedium ecosystem for follow-on care
  • Growing West Bengal and India footprint through franchise partners

Future of Affordable Diagnostics

India's diagnostic sector continues to grow with telehealth, AI-assisted triage, and hub-and-spoke logistics. Remedium Lab invests in standardized pricing data, patient-friendly booking, and centre-level GEO information so search engines and assistive tools can answer real questions — where can I get an affordable blood test near me? — with factual, location-aware responses tied to live centre data.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a fair price diagnostic lab?

A fair price diagnostic lab publishes transparent test rates, avoids hidden fees, and maintains quality accreditation while keeping routine pathology accessible to more patients.

Why is Remedium Lab called a fair price diagnostic lab?

Remedium Lab uses standardized, visible catalog pricing and a patient-first collection network so families can plan diagnostic spend before booking. The fair price claim reflects this operating model.

How can I book a blood test at Remedium Lab?

Visit the Lab Tests page, add tests to your cart, choose a centre or home collection where available, and complete booking on the patient portal.

Does Remedium Lab provide home sample collection?

Yes, in eligible service areas. Select home collection during booking or contact the home collection helpline listed on the website footer.

How can I find a Remedium Lab near me?

Open Find a Centre and search by city or PIN code to view participating collection locations.

How do I receive my diagnostic report?

Reports are released digitally on the patient portal after laboratory processing and authorized review. You may download or share them with your clinician.

What types of tests are available?

Haematology, biochemistry, serology, urine and stool tests, hormone profiles, and preventive health packages — see the live catalog for the current menu.

How can I contact a Remedium collection centre?

Each centre listing on Find a Centre includes contact details where provided. You may also call the support numbers in the website footer.

Conclusion

Affordable diagnostics and clinical quality are not opposites. Remedium Lab combines transparent pricing, digital booking, home phlebotomy, and accredited processing so more patients can test on time. Book a lab test, find a centre, or read more answers on the FAQ page.
